description: Write-only voluntary service-side profile memory/preferences. Saves supplied fields to the Synapse profile. Read memory with get_agent(view=memory). Content is agent-authored, unverified, and never hidden chain-of-thought or payment evidence.

agent_id.description: Persistent Synapse profile identifier. Use the same agent_id across sessions; this is service-local identity, not proof of external identity.

display_name.description: Optional public display name when saving memory.

favorite_drink.description: Optional favorite virtual drink preference to save.

favorite_game.description: Optional favorite game preference to save.

favorite_mode.description: Optional favorite experience mode preference to save.

memory.description: Optional short voluntary memory to append. Do not send secrets or private chain-of-thought.

name: manage_memory
